ROOT_CAUSE_DETAIL: Combination of (B) cumulative candidate retention via expand_all_templates materializing all composite definitions with embedded signals lists, (A) one large fixed allocation of all 582 atomic stream records (events + duplicate available_at strings) via load_stream_cache pickle, and (C/D) DataFrame.copy + merge_asof temps per evaluate call while bars_by_tf for all SEARCH_TFs remained resident.

atomic_stream_cache.mechanism: pickle.load(atomic_streams_cache_v1.pkl) into dict[cid]->record with events[] and available_at[]

context_state_cache.mechanism: rebuilt per composite via build_state_timeline (list[StateEvent]); no bar matrix

bars_by_tf.mechanism: all SEARCH_TFs loaded for DEVELOPMENT window at compose start

event_evaluation_frames.mechanism: events.copy() twice per evaluate_signals_window + merge_asof temps

candidate_definitions.mechanism: expand_all_templates returns full list; each entry embeds signals[]

composite_event_streams.mechanism: retained on every composite dict until end of evaluate loop

results_accumulated_in_memory.mechanism: result_rows + fold_rows lists until all composites finish; then DataFrame

dedup_jaccard_structures.mechanism: pre-compose only; avail_sets for all active configs during representative write
